response.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_total_cost / ili.derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;
